work_authorization.notes_for_unclear_forms: Authorization and sponsorship are two different questions; answer both as given, never map one onto the other.

compensation._two_different_uses: screening_rule decides whether to apply; answer_strategy decides what to enter on a form. They are separate.
compensation.base_salary_floor: <your screening floor in whole dollars, e.g. 150000>
compensation.screening_rule: Apply only if the posting's published UPPER band >= base_salary_floor; a ceiling below it is a hard skip.
compensation.answer_strategy: Defer wherever the field accepts text ('open / flexible / market'); enter the target number only where a number is mandatory.
compensation.field_handling: <your target number in whole dollars, e.g. 185000>

targets.relocation_policy: Answer Yes if ANY location on the eligible list appears.

voluntary_self_identification.notes: Decline / prefer-not-to-say / leave blank on all demographic fields unless the user opts in.

never_guess: any field with no confirmed answer — print ASK and stop

never_claim._why: Terms the candidate must never be described as having — the skill refuses to submit anything asserting these.
never_claim._rule: If a résumé draft or form answer drifts toward one of these, stop.

confirmed_facts._note: Verified specifics the candidate can cite (post-merger systems, named metrics, etc.). Empty at start; fill as confirmed.
